record.title: Replace incompatible shell stat with a tested native metadata probe
record.intent: Validate descriptor and device identity without device opening or I2C operations.
requirements: Implement bounded ARM64 metadata-only stat following a requested path, reporting mode/device numbers/inode with no device open or ioctl.
Prove node and proc-descriptor following and failures in host controls and the pinned disposable guest; preserve earlier acquisition failure.
Adapt and validate fresh controller binding and independent verification to raw native metadata.
acceptance: Adapter identity no longer depends on unsupported shell stat options.
